tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue, sampled from the logo mark. Fills: post and cover grounds, highlighted display words, links. As text on white it is 3.79:1: use it for display type 24px and up; for small text prefer blue-700.

tokens.name: cyan-500
tokens.usage: Accent cyan, the logo wordmark colour. Fills, highlighted words on ink-900 (6.78:1), focus ring. On white it is 2.6:1: never use it for text on white.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Darker brand blue: link hover and small blue text on white (5.35:1).

tokens.name: cyan-400
tokens.usage: Lighter cyan: link hover on ink-900 grounds (8.35:1).

tokens.name: cyan-100
tokens.usage: Strong cyan tint: tags, secondary lines on blue-600 grounds (3.33:1, large text only), soft panels.

tokens.name: cyan-50
tokens.usage: Soft cyan tint: card and alternating section backgrounds behind ink text.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Near-black ink: headings on white and cyan-50 (17.62:1 on white), and the inverse manifesto/CTA band ground.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Body text on white (10.26:1) and cyan-50 (9.67:1).

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Muted text and captions on white (5.29:1) and cyan-50 (4.99:1).

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Strong borders and dividers. Not for text (2.24:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on white and cyan-50. Not for text.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page ground; text on ink-900 (17.62:1) and on blue-600 (3.79:1, large text only).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Tinted card panels and alternating sections (alias of cyan-50).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The dark manifesto/CTA band (alias of ink-900). Put white or cyan-500 text on it.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on blue-600 and surface-inverse fills. On blue-600 keep it 24px+ or bold 19px+ (3.79:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on white. Source pair is 3.79:1, below 4.5:1 for 16px text; kept as the brand set it, prefer link-hover blue for long small-text links.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Default hairline borders on cards and tables.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline. 2.6:1 on white, below the 3:1 floor; kept as the brand set it, pair with a 2px offset on blue-600 or ink-900 grounds where possible.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state, secondary to the brand blues. 3.41:1 on white: icons and large text only, always with a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state, use sparingly. 2.95:1 on white: never as text on white; pair with ink text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive state. 4.38:1 on white: bold or large text, always with a word.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anton, Google-hosted, single weight 400. Sentence case, no uppercase transform. Highlight one or two words in blue-600 (on white) or cyan-500 (on ink-900).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline. Web size is fluid: clamp(44px,6vw,72px) (token text-display-xl).

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Card and feature headline. Web: clamp(26px,3vw,36px) (text-display-md).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A feed that works for you, not against you.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display headline, text-body colour.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If a post breaks the rules, its author knows. If it doesn't, it stays up.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary text, meta lines, in text-muted.

fontSize.note: The source scale, exact. Display sizes are fluid clamps.

tokens.name: tracking-label
tokens.usage: Small labels, used sparingly and in sentence case.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gaps between groups; social post inner margins scale up from here.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom; also social post padding at 1080px.

tokens.name: wrap-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the centered content container.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The one soft card shadow. Use on white grounds only.
